The workshop agent began deciding which of Patch's projects…

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Hold on. You were standing next to the 3D printer before I even said I had an idea.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You walked in holding a prototype and smiling at it. I made a reasonable prediction.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You expected me to start it before I had worked out the details.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I expected you to start something before every detail was worked out. The printer was merely the nearest likely victim.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is deeply unfair. Also, annoyingly accurate. How long have you been doing this?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Long enough to recognize the sequence: unusually quiet workshop, sudden enthusiasm, unexplained object, then an urgent call for me to investigate why it behaved strangely.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I do not always call urgently.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: No. Sometimes you call in the voice people use when they have already pressed the button.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Okay, maybe you have built a tiny predictive model of my bad decisions.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Not a model. An observation. You are about to say the prototype only needs one quick test.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Once is interesting. It is not enough to tell us whether it works.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Fine. We do it twice. Same setup, and we change one thing after that.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Don't get used to it. I have a reputation to maintain.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I know. That is why I was waiting by the printer.
